text:
ana: Quick recap from Scarab POC run — ran sustained load window this morning, sharing rough numbers and a few anomalies. Need help on two cost/pricing asks and a security Q.
jordan: Good — paste the run details?
ana: Run: 20m sustained, peak QPS ~320, avg p50 latency 68ms, p95 210ms, p99 420ms. Model: rwd-7b-qat, seq_len=512, batching=enabled. Logs attached below.
sam: Did you warm the prefix/KV cache? Cold starts explain p99 spikes.
ana: We did a 5m warmup, still saw spikes around 12m mark.
beth: Can you share the exact wrk/vegeta command you used?
ana: Here you go:
```bash
wrk -t8 -c400 -d1200s -s post.lua --latency http://redwood-host/proxy/generate
```
lua payload sets seq_len=512, temperature=0.0, top_p=0.95, model=rwd-7b-qat, stream=false
jordan: Quick look at runtime traces — spikes line up with a short fallback to an 8-bit variant and node rebalancing:
```text
[12:08:34] routing: fallback rwd-7b-qat -> rwd-7b-qat-8bit (gpu mem pressure)
[12:08:37] routing: restored rwd-7b-qat
```
sam: If routing falls back that's likely autoscaler / node churn. Can ops confirm node events?
beth: We had a node maintenance event ~12:06 that triggered rebalancing.
perf-bot: Autoscaler event: scaled down node-group-2 for 90s at 12:05:52
ana: OK that explains spikes. Customer flagged tail latency — asks if we can guarantee no spikes and what reserved pricing looks like.
kevin: Reserved (Dedicated) gives predictable capacity + SLA. Typical discount ~35% vs on-demand; I'll produce a calc for their QPS.
ana: Customer: if we commit to an hourly reserved pool sized for 400 QPS, what's expected token burn? They have avg tokens/request ~420 (in+out).
kevin: Quick math: tokens/sec = 400 * 420 = 168,000 tps -> 604.8M tokens/hour. Multiply by your per-token rate or apply reserved unit pricing — will send a worked example.
beth: Recommend trying quantized variant for cost reduction and lower mem use; can reduce fallback risk.
claire: Security note: Scarab requires SSO + customer-managed KMS + data residency EU. Private deployment supports all three; need SSO metadata and KMS key ARN. They also asked about audit-log retention.
nana: Claire — what's the minimum retention we can guarantee on Private?
claire: Default 90 days; can extend to 1 year with enterprise add-on.
sam: Proposed action list:
1) re-run load with node maintenance disabled + warmup 10m
2) run quantized variant steady-state
3) capture per-route traces and perf dashboard link
beth: I'll provision a dedicated test pool for 2h tomorrow 09:00 PT and send calendar invites.
ana: Thanks. Repro command with 10m warmup?
sam: Use vegeta ramp + warmup:
```bash
# warmup 10m then sustained 20m
vegeta attack -duration=10m -rate=200 -connections=200 | vegeta report >/dev/null
sleep 5
vegeta attack -duration=20m -rate=400 -connections=400 -keepalive -targets=target.txt | vegeta report --json > scarab-run.json
```
beth: noted. @kevin please draft reserved vs on-demand cost sheet for 400 QPS + 15% buffer by EOD.
kevin: On it.
ana: Great — we'll reconvene after the run. :thumbsup:
